remarks: Luxury, light, and opportunity come together in this stunning brand-new Leduc home that’s ready to impress from the moment you arrive. Offering 2,090 sq ft of modern design, this home features 9 ft ceilings and large windows throughout for a bright, open feel. The main floor includes an open-concept layout with a stylish living room and sleek fireplace, a beautiful kitchen with walk-in pantry, and a spacious dining area perfect for everyday living and entertaining, plus a den, 4-piece bathroom, mudroom, and separate entrance for added flexibility. Upstairs offers a large bonus room, upper-level laundry, three bedrooms, including a primary suite with walk-in closet and spa-inspired 5-piece ensuite, plus an additional 4-piece bathroom. The undeveloped basement with separate entrance provides excellent future suite or income potential. Complete with an attached double garage and ample storage, this home is in a growing Leduc community on a west-facing lot close to schools, parks, shopping, and golf courses. (id:67522)
